That day I felt, wish I knew English. I wouldn't have lost my job and would have got some respect too. Then I saw the English Seekho ad. I immediately downloaded the app on my phone and watched videos daily. While everyone wastes time watching videos on Instagram and YouTube, I learned English by watching videos, and also practiced with Disha maam on the app. Disha maam is an AI teacher, not a human, so she doesn't judge. She doesn't make fun either. She directly tells what is wrong and how to correct it. Now I speak English very well. And to tell the truth, even better than the madam. You try it yourself. Take a 3-day trial for 1 rupee and see. Install the English Seekho app and learn English.]
